S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major change in responsibilities at work (e.g., promotion, demotion)
patient_info.stressor: As Clifford was easing toward a part-time advisory role, his employer asked him to temporarily resume full operational leadership during a difficult cloud migration and cybersecurity compliance push, delaying the retirement rhythm he had been building around fishing, gardening, church concerts, and mentoring. He initially framed the low mood, altered sleep, appetite changes, and tiredness as ordinary strain from being needed again, but the pattern continued across two years and four months even after the migration stabilized. His impairment remained mild but noticeable: he still met essential obligations, yet he missed routine appointments, let his garden go unattended, and found himself withdrawing from some community activities he had usually enjoyed. He sought psychiatric care on his own after an employee wellness screening and a conversation with his primary-care physician helped him recognize that the persistent course was more than normal work fatigue.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: For a long time now there’s been this gray, flat feeling most days, where even things I used to look forward to like fishing, tending the tomatoes, or a church concert feel like items on a checklist instead of something I enjoy.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.
S026.manifestation: My appetite has been off more days than not, so I’ll work through lunch without noticing and then pick at dinner, and my wife has pointed out my pants are looser even though I’m not trying to lose weight.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: I usually fall asleep all right, but I wake up around four with my mind already sorting through server issues or compliance deadlines, and then I just lie there until the alarm feeling like the night didn’t really count.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: Mostly I came in because I’m tired in a way that doesn’t make sense—I can sleep, keep up at work, and still feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even gets going.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’m still getting the essential work done, but I’ve missed routine appointments, let the garden go, and backed out of some church and community things I used to be reliable for.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on since I was pulled back into full operational leadership, about two years and four months ago.
